title: Invisible Death Messages
description: This very lightweight plugin makes it so when people get killed by an invisible player, the name gets blurred in the death message. This adds extra mystery and confusion to your survival SMP!
body: This very lightweight plugin makes it so when people get killed by an invisible player, the name gets blurred in the death message. This adds extra mystery and confusion to your survival SMP! This plugin needs no dependencies, and is available for PaperMC 26.1.2. Future versions will be released soon!
